tools.cli: --tools Bash,Read,Edit,Write (K1, launch-agent.sh reads builtIn from this file)
tools.rationale: every arm needs only to read and edit files and run a shell (source the env file, dotnet test, git, praxis in C/D); Echelon arms reach Praxis through Bash. The four tools are a subset of the Claude Code 2.1.306 default set, so no capability is added; sub-agents, web, notebook, scheduling, worktree, skill and tool-search tools are removed
tools.evidence: research/token-efficiency/prefix/PREFIX-COMPOSITION.md (exploratory probes: first-request context 16,513 -> 5,821 tokens, n=3 each)

invocation.K1: isolated-cli: one headless `claude -p` process per trial (harness/launch-agent.sh), fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, fresh --session-id, per-trial nonce in --append-system-prompt, --tools from .tools.builtIn, no MCP servers, trials run one at a time
invocation.K0: subagent-shared: Agent tool, subagent_type=general-purpose, fresh context per trial, foreground (run-02 condition; prompt-cache prefix shared with the orchestrator); the Agent tool cannot take --tools, so K0 keeps the general-purpose sub-agent tool set (identical across arms, but not the K1 profile; recorded if P1 selects K0)

prompt: You are a software engineer doing one bounded task. Your complete instructions are in the brief at {BRIEF}. Read it first and follow it exactly, including its limits and workflow, and end your final message as the brief says.
promptNote: identical wrapper in every arm and cache condition (the run-02 wrapper, byte for byte); {BRIEF} is the absolute path of the workspace's AGENT_BRIEF.md written by run-03/harness/setup.sh
